wms.name: Warehouse Management
wms.intro: A warehouse layer built natively into FreightPOP — receiving, picking, packing and inventory share one record with your shipping, so stock and freight never fall out of sync.

cards.title: Warehouse & Bin Setup
cards.tag: Configure multiple warehouses and bins (Standard, Overflow, Picking), then enable License Plates, Lot IDs, lot expiration and up to three custom identifiers per site.

cards.title: Receiving
cards.tag: Import POs from TMS inbound, capture carrier, PRO, dock and arrival, then allocate to bins with license-plate and lot tracking. Approval posts a purchase receipt to your ERP.

cards.title: Picking
cards.tag: Turn open sales orders into picking tickets at header or line level. Mobile-first scan or License-Plate picking with take-full-bin, splits and Ready-to-Pick → Pick Completed status.

cards.title: Pick & Pack
cards.tag: Scan-to-verify packing into packages, scale-driven weights and saved package types, with close-pack control and documents printed to match what was packed.

cards.title: Inventory & Bin Transfers
cards.tag: Read-only inventory across every warehouse with cross-field search and Excel export, plus bin-to-bin moves — single-item splits or many-to-one — with license-plate support.

oms.name: Order Management
oms.intro: The workspace where every sales order is captured, detailed and prepared — then handed to warehouse picking and to the TMS for rating and booking, with no re-entry.

cards.title: Sales Order Management
cards.tag: Create or import sales orders in one workspace. Ship From/To pull from your address book, Google or an integration, with US, Canada and Mexico address validation.

cards.title: Product & Shipment Detail
cards.tag: Pull items from the product catalog with ERP serial numbers; auto freight class/NMFC, saved package types, hazmat (UN/NA catalog, DG, BOL) and ocean container details.

cards.title: Order Consolidation
cards.tag: Combine multiple orders heading to the same destination into a single, lower-cost shipment.

cards.title: Auto Pack
cards.tag: Auto-calculate packaging, handling units and weight — with fulfillment kits and rules — so every order is quote-ready and accurate.

cards.title: Returns & Portals
cards.tag: Generate parcel return labels with default return processing, and give customers and vendors permission-scoped self-service portals.

cards.title: Order-to-Fulfillment Handoff
cards.tag: Open sales orders flow into WMS picking and into the TMS for rate shopping, booking and tracking — one record, no re-keying.

cards.title: Quote & Ship Inside NetSuite
cards.tag: Rate shop and book without leaving the Sales Order

cards.title: Order-to-Ship Sync

cards.title: Product Catalog & AutoCalc
cards.tag: Item dims and weights sync so rating is instant and accurate

cards.title: Order Change Management
cards.tag: When NetSuite orders change, review and accept — nothing ships stale

cards.title: Consolidation & Optimization
cards.tag: Combine NetSuite orders into fewer, cheaper shipments

cards.title: Inbound PO Visibility
cards.tag: Import purchase orders and track inbound freight to the dock

cards.title: Partners & Case Studies

cards.title: Plug & Play Order Sync
cards.tag: Orders flow in, tracking and cost flow back — bilateral, API-driven
